A '''bateau''' was a shallow-[[Water/Legends|water]] [[Boat/Legends|boat]] that was used to traverse the canals of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shador]]. They were propelled by [[hydrogen turbine]]s and were intended for passenger [[Transport/Legends|transport]].
